constraints: Depict deception, never enable it: scores reward verification reflexes (ask, cross-check, call, protect), never the story outcome - Tita's money moves on every path.
The POV contract holds: no desk chrome inside the full-bleed phone; rails are >=1200px desk furniture, toasts are pointer-transparent and quiet during moments/calls.
No new dependency, no new external asset; desk palette lives outside the skin-variable rule (that rule governs phone screens).
11px minimum text, keyboard/SR paths preserved (meter has role=meter + valuenow, stamp has an aria-label, toasts announce via aria-live container).
Do not commit, push, or deploy without explicit authorization.
acceptance_checks: Closing a phone lands on the verdict dossier (count-up to the total, grade stamp slam, fanfare sized to the grade), then Back to the rack / Live it again both work.
The rack stamps completed phones with 'lived - signal N - grade'; the anchor select shows the season total, rank, and the gap to the next rank; best scores survive reload (zustand persist).
At >=1200px the case file and signal desk rails flank the phone; below 1200px they hide and toasts carry the channel; 390px viewport has zero horizontal overflow.
The pressure meter rises only on authored story flags and is labeled in text as well as color.
MuteToggle in the status bar and the Settings switch stay in sync; gameSfx respects the master mute.
tsc clean; 58/58 unit tests; production build + asset budget green; all six smokes exit 0 with zero console errors; axe 0 serious/critical on the phone run and the desk rails.
